The exhaustive upstream projection is mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:7-23,38-100; orderid appears only inside the opaque UUID at line 20, which cannot be inverted. reopen_history.reason: Type B cast defect: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(REGEXP_REPLACE(col, offset-strip), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss[.SSSSSS]") returns NULL on any shape the pinned format misses (date-only values especially), and TRY_ makes it silent -- those NULLs reach the judge as differing_null_only/gap_shaped, i.e. a parse failure disguised as a FHIR coverage gap at the lower bar. Replace every datetime mapping with a bare TRY_CAST(col AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ). See pathling-sql SKILL.md and MIMIC_NOTES.md:337.
